name: Isolated Megalopapilla

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Ophthalmological Diagnostic Criteria for Isolated Megalopapilla

criteria.description: Optic disc diameter significantly larger than normal (>2.1 mm horizontally)
Preserved normal visual acuity and visual fields without glaucomatous changes
No evidence of elevated intraocular pressure or glaucomatous optic neuropathy
Normal retinal vascular pattern without anomalies
Can be unilateral or bilateral presentation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of enlarged optic disc with normal visual function and absence of glaucoma
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by ophthalmologic imaging and exclusion of glaucoma

pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic large optic nerve head without pathological cupping

pathognomonic.symptomName: Normal visual acuity despite optic disc enlargement
searchTerms: normal vision despite large optic nerve
good eyesight with optic disc swelling
clear vision with optic nerve enlargement

common.symptomName: Unilateral or bilateral optic disc enlargement
searchTerms: one or both optic nerves enlarged
optic disc bigger in one or both eyes
swollen optic nerve head unilateral or bilateral

common.symptomName: Absence of glaucomatous visual field defects
Normal retinal nerve fiber layer thickness
searchTerms: normal thickness of nerve fiber layer in retina
mild tissue changes around optic nerve
small area of tissue thinning around optic nerve

occasional.symptomName: Slightly increased cup-to-disc ratio without glaucomatous damage
searchTerms: slightly larger optic cup without glaucoma
increased cup to disc ratio but no damage
optic nerve cup bigger but healthy

occasional.symptomName: Asymmetry in optic disc size between eyes
searchTerms: unequal optic nerve sizes between eyes
one optic disc larger than the other
difference in optic nerve head size

occasional.symptomName: Occasional mild visual field irregularities not consistent with glaucoma
searchTerms: visual field spots not due to glaucoma
small bleeding spots on optic nerve
tiny blood spots near optic nerve

imaging: Enlarged optic nerve head on fundus photography
Normal optical coherence tomography (OCT) of retinal nerve fiber layer

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of colobomatous excavation of optic disc

references: Hoyt WF, et al. Megalopapilla: clinical and pathologic features. Arch Ophthalmol. 1975.
Kanski JJ, Bowling B. Clinical Ophthalmology: A Systematic Approach. 8th Edition. 2015.
